answer: Require each identity to hold a hardware-backed key and answer a simultaneous 90-second liveness challenge each epoch: when the beacon, nicknamed raven, fires at an unpredictable time, every key must sign it within 90 seconds. A phone secure enclave is no relic—it enforces one key per device, so running 500 Sybils needs 500 physical devices at about 0 each (0,000) plus power and connectivity for all of them at once, with no reuse across the nebula of fakes.
